brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, elevated expected shortfalls, and uniformly modest conviction warrant reduced exposure. BTC and ETH longs are fragile because their edge is slight and ETH carries higher beta and volatility. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have weak or adverse alpha and institutional/liquidity signals. SOL is effectively flat with negative alpha. ETC is critically fragile: price, volatility, liquidity, and risk fields are zero, indicating invalid or missing data; do not rely on its long signal.
